title: Raft replication per shard
statement: The system shall replicate every shard using the Raft consensus protocol with an odd number of voting replicas (default 3) placed in distinct availability zones.
rationale: PO decision: distributed, sharded, strong consistency via Raft.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every shard has 3 or 5 voting replicas; even voter counts are rejected by configuration validation.
With 3 AZs available, no two voters of the same shard are placed in the same AZ.
